blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recovering 3D structure and camera motion from images is a foundational problem in computer vision. Classical Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo pipelines Schönberger and Frahm (2016) ; Schönberger et al. (2016) ; Furukawa and Ponce (2009) estimate camera poses from multi-view correspondences and reconstruct geometry through photometric or geometric consistency, often regularized by hand-crafted priors. While effective when input views provide sufficient texture, overlap, and coverage, this geometric paradigm becomes brittle in sparse object-centric settings, where only a few uncalibrated views are available and large object regions go unrecovered.
blocks.zh: 从图像中恢复3D结构和相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基础问题. 古典结构-从运动和多维立体管Schönberger和Frahm(2016年);Schönberger等人(2016年);Furukawa和Ponce(2009年)从多景通信中估计相机的姿势,通过光度或几何一致性重建几何,常由手工前身规范化. 当输入视图提供了足够的纹理、重叠和覆盖时,这种几何范式虽然有效,但在以物体为中心的稀少环境中变得脆弱,只有少数未校准的视图可供使用,大型物体区域无法恢复。

blocks.en: Such settings are common in practice, from robotic manipulation to AR capture and content-creation pipelines, all of which need a holistic 3D representation to reason about occluded surfaces and contact regions. Sparse-view 3D object recovery therefore requires more than triangulating visible evidence: it must infer a complete 3D explanation that is both consistent with the input images and plausible as an object, jointly answering what the object is and where each view was taken from.
blocks.zh: 这种设置在实践中很常见,从机器人操纵到AR捕获和内容创建管道,所有这一切都需要一个整体的3D表示,到对被占据的表面和接触区域有理性. 因此,Sparse-view 3D对象恢复需要的不仅仅是三角化的可见证据:它必须推断出一个完整的3D解释,这个解释既符合输入图像,又作为对象可信,共同回答对象是什么以及每个视图是从哪里取来的.

blocks.en: Recent learning-based methods relax the texture and overlap assumptions of classical pipelines by introducing large-scale data-driven priors. Feed-forward reconstructors Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) predict camera parameters and pixel-aligned 3D representations jointly, while pose-centric works Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Sinha et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) estimate relative camera motion under limited overlap and pose ambiguity. Both threads remain primarily observation-driven: they recover what the input views support but do not explicitly model the distribution of complete object shapes, leaving outputs incomplete in unobserved regions when input coverage is poor.
blocks.zh: 最近采用基于学习的方法,通过引入大规模的数据驱动前传,放松了古典管道的纹理和重叠假设. Feed 前置重建器 王等人 (2024年); 勒罗伊等人 (2024年); 王等人. (2025) 预测相机参数和像素对齐的 3D 表示,同时配置为中心作品 张等人(2022年);王等人(2023年);辛亥等人(2023年); 张等人(2024a)在有限的重叠下估计相对相机运动,并造成模糊. 这两个线程仍然主要是观察驱动的:它们恢复输入视图支持的内容,但没有明确模拟完整对象形状的分布,在输入覆盖面差的情况下,使未观察区域的产出不完整。

blocks.en: A complementary line of work introduces generative priors learned from large-scale 3D datasets Deitke et al. (2023) into sparse reconstruction. View-based generative SfM Zhao et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Xu et al. (2024a) ; Zhao and Tulsiani (2024) casts structure and motion as a generative problem in view space, while reconstruct-then-generate pipelines Ardelean et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Chang et al. (2025) ; Team et al. (2025) ; Siddiqui et al. (2026) pair feed-forward reconstructors with native 3D generators Tochilkin et al. (2024) ; Xiang et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) . The latter family in particular has shown that 3D generative priors can complete hidden geometry that observation-driven methods cannot. These systems remain cascaded: an external module predicts poses or image-aligned representations and the 3D generator only completes the result, propagating errors across stages and preventing joint optimization of a single 3D hypothesis that explains all input views.
blocks.zh: 一项补充性的工作将从大型立体数据集Deitke等人(2023年)学到的遗传学前科引入稀疏的重建. 基于景色的基因化SfM Zhao等人(2025a); 张等人(2024b) ;徐等人(2024a) ;赵和图尔西阿尼(2024) 将结构和运动铸成视空间的基因问题,同时重建当时的基因管道 Ardelean等人(2025) ;黄等人(2026) ; 张等人(2025) ; Team等人(2025) ; Siddiqui等人(2026) 配有本地3D发电机 Tochilkin等人(2024) ; Xiang等人(2025) ; 赵等人(2025b) 。 后者尤其表明,3D基因前科可以完成观察驱动方法不能完成的隐藏几何学. 这些系统仍然是级联的:一个外部模块预测了形而上学或图像对齐的表示,3D生成器只完成结果,跨阶段传播错误,并防止对解释所有输入视图的单一3D假说进行联合优化.

blocks.en: In this paper, we invert this pipeline: instead of using a generative prior to complete the output of a feed-forward reconstructor, we treat the 3D generative prior itself as the primary reasoning mechanism for sparse-view reconstruction. We propose GenSfM , an end-to-end framework that formulates joint recovery of complete object structure and per-view camera motion as a single conditional inference problem in a native 3D diffusion model, as shown in Fig. 1 . The diffusion prior operates directly on a native 3D representation throughout inference, simultaneously denoising shape and per-view pose under joint self-attention. This grounds the generated object in the observed views while using object-level regularities to infer unobserved geometry.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们颠倒了这个管道:我们不是在完成向导重建器的输出前使用基因组,而是将3D基因前本身作为稀释视觉重建的主要推理机制. 我们提出GENSfM,一个端到端框架,将完全对象结构的联合恢复和per-view相机运动作为本地3D扩散模型中单一有条件的推论问题,如图1所示. 事先的传播直接在本地的3D代表上进行,贯穿整个推论,同时在共同的自觉下去点名造型和透视姿势. 这说明在观测到的视图中生成的物体是合理的,同时利用物体水平的规律来推断未观测到的几何.

blocks.en: Realizing this formulation requires a single diffusion transformer that jointly denoises a shared 3D shape with a per-view pose latent bound to its input image, while keeping the per-view pose-token overhead small as views are added. We adopt CUPID ’s Huang et al. (2025) 3D-native UV-volume pose tokenization, but compress each view’s pose latent to a compact token grid, since the dense volume over-parameterizes a low-DoF perspective projection. A learned view embedding tags each view’s pose latent and image tokens, binding pose to its source image. Since neither stream natively carries cross-view information, we prepend a small set of register tokens to the shape stream as a shared channel for all views to communicate through self-attention.
blocks.zh: 实现这种配方需要一台单一的扩散变压器,将一个共享的三维形状与每个视图共同染色,使其输入图像具有潜在的束缚作用,同时随着视图的添加,使每个视图的平面起伏较小。 我们采用CUPID的Huang等人(2025年)的3D-内置紫外线容量表示符号化,但压缩每个视图对紧凑的信号网构成潜在作用,因为密集的量超参数化了低剂量的视差预测。 学习到的视图嵌入每个视图的标记会呈现潜在的和图像的符号,对它的源图像装订姿势. 由于两个溪流在本土上都没有带交叉视图信息,所以我们预先将一组小的寄存符放在形状溪流上,作为所有视图通过自觉交流的共享通道.

blocks.en: Instead of relying on back-projection to recover surface texture like feed-forward methods ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , we add a second stage of native 3D refinement and texturing ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) so that hidden regions stay coherent with the observed views. We design a pose-aware fine stage that, using the cameras predicted in the coarse stage, projects every active voxel into the input views and conditions denoising on per-voxel semantic and texture features sampled and averaged across views.
blocks.zh: 我们没有像饲料推进方法(Wang et al., 2024)那样依赖背向投影来恢复表面纹理,而是增加了第二个阶段的原生3D精细化和纹理(Xiang et al., 2025),这样隐藏区域就能够与观测到的观点保持一致. 我们设计了一个能感知到的精细舞台,利用粗糙阶段预测的相机,将每个活性阴道投射到输入视图和条件中去,在每伏xel语义和纹理特征上进行抽样和平均观测。

blocks.en:

(2025) , while recovering input-view camera poses to over 96 % 96\% Acc@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} (a 5 × 5\times rotation-error reduction over the strongest pose baseline VGGT Wang et al. (2025) ) without requiring known intrinsics.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose GenSfM , a joint native-3D architecture that recasts a diffusion model from a post-hoc completion module into the primary inference mechanism for joint sparse-view structure and motion recovery, eliminating any external feed-forward reconstruction backbone. • A 3D-native multi-view pose tokenization that places per-view UV-volume pose latents and the shape latent in a single multi-modal sequence, jointly denoised by a diffusion transformer under shared self-attention. • A pose-aware fine stage that, with cameras recovered from the coarse stage, anchors semantic and texture features at every active voxel and averages them across views, sharpening surface detail beyond global, pose-agnostic conditioning.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sparse-view object reconstruction must jointly answer two coupled questions: what is the 3D object, and where was each view taken from? What requires both visible and hidden object structure, while where requires the camera motion relating the input views. Existing methods typically excel on one side or address the two with separate models stacked in series (Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: Sparse-view 对象重建必须共同回答两个结合的问题:3D对象是什么,每个视图是从哪里取来的? 需要可见和隐藏的物体结构,同时需要相机运动与输入视图相关. 现有方法一般在一边优异,或用连续堆叠的单独模型处理两者(第1段)。

blocks.en:
Table 1 : Comparison of paradigms for sparse-view object structure-and-motion recovery.
“Where” denotes camera-motion recovery and “what” denotes object-structure recovery, with observed and hidden geometry referring to visible and unobserved object regions, respectively.
“Unified joint inference” means jointly recovering complete object structure and camera motion in one model, while “native 3D prior” denotes a generative prior over complete 3D shapes.
✓: explicit support; △ \triangle : partial or indirect support; –: not a primary objective.

表1:稀视对象结构与运动恢复范式比较.
“哪里”表示相机运动恢复,“什么”表示物体结构恢复,观测到的和隐藏的几何分别指可见和未观测的物体区域。
“单一联合推论”是指在一个模型中共同恢复完整的物体结构和相机运动,而“本地3D先导”是指在三维外形之前的基因。

blocks.en: Pose-centric approaches Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Sinha et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) target the where side, regressing relative camera motion under limited overlap and pose ambiguity, but leave what largely untouched. More general feed-forward reconstructors Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) predict dense pointmaps, correspondences, and camera parameters jointly, addressing camera motion and visible geometry; hidden geometry, however, is recovered only indirectly through learned priors.
blocks.zh: 以政治为中心的方法 张等人(2022年);王等人(2023年);辛亥等人(2023年); Zhang等人(2024a)针对一方,在有限的重叠条件下倒退相对相机运动,并造成模糊,但留下基本上未触及的内容。 更普通的向导重建器 王等人 (2024年); 勒罗伊等人 (2024年); 王等人. (2025年)共同预测密集点图,函射,和相机参数,处理相机运动和可见几何;然而,隐藏几何只是通过学到的前传间接恢复.

blocks.en: Native 3D generators trained on large 3D corpora Deitke et al. (2023) , such as TripoSR Tochilkin et al. (2024) , TRELLIS Xiang et al. (2025) , and Hunyuan3D Zhao et al. (2025b) , are strong on what : complete object structure is modeled explicitly and hidden geometry is hallucinated from the prior. They do not target where : camera motion is typically assumed and only weakly encoded through cross-attention, so applied directly to uncalibrated sparse views they can produce plausible but misaligned geometry.
blocks.zh: 培训大型3D公司Deitke等人(2023年)的原生3D发电机,如TripoSR Tochilkin等人(2024年),TRELLIS Xiang等人(2025年),以及Hunyuan3D Zhao et al. (2025b),在什么上很强:完全的物体结构被明确模型化,隐藏的几何从前作中产生幻觉. 它们不瞄准以下地点: 相机运动通常被假设, 并且只能通过交叉注意进行微弱的编码, 因此直接适用于未校准的稀疏视图, 它们可以产生合理但错位的几何。

blocks.en: View-based generative SfM Zhao et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Xu et al. (2024a) ; Zhao and Tulsiani (2024) casts what and where as a joint generative problem in view space; DiffusionSfM, for instance, diffuses ray origins and endpoints to recover per-view geometry and camera motion jointly. Because diffusion operates over view-based quantities (rays, pointmaps, depths), hidden what is recovered only insofar as it can be back-projected from individual views.
blocks.zh: 基于景色的基因化SfM Zhao等人(2025a); 张等(2024b) ; 徐等(2024a) ; 赵和图尔西阿尼(2024) 在视野空间中将什么和什么地方作为共同的基因问题投放; 例如,扩散SfM, 扩散射线源和端点, 以共同恢复每个视野的几何和相机运动. 因为扩散运行于基于视图的量(射线,点映射,深度)上,只有从个人的视角可以反射出才能回收的隐藏物.

blocks.en: Reconstruct-then-generate pipelines Ardelean et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Chang et al. (2025) ; Team et al. (2025) ; Siddiqui et al. (2026) ; Yao et al. (2025) couple feed-forward reconstruction with native 3D generators: e.g., ReconViaGen Chang et al. (2025) injects VGGT Wang et al. (2025) geometry tokens into a 3D generator. These pipelines recover hidden geometry through the generative prior while grounding camera motion and visible structure with feed-forward geometry, but solve what and where in separate stages, so errors from the reconstruction backbone propagate into a 3D hypothesis that need not remain coherent with all input views.
blocks.zh: 重建当时的基因管道 Ardelean等人(2025年); Huang等人(2026年);Chang等人(2025年);Team等人(2025年);Siddiqui等人(2026年);Yao等人(2025年)夫妇用本地3D发电机进行饲料重建:例如ReconViaGen 昌等人(2025年)注射了VGGT Wang等人. (2025)几何符号成3D生成器. 这些管道通过先期的基因恢复隐藏几何,同时将相机运动和可见结构与向导几何固定在地面上,但在不同的阶段和地点解决什么问题,因此重建骨干的错误传播到一个不需要与所有输入视图保持一致的3D假说中.

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: Given N N uncalibrated multi-view images ℐ = { 𝐈 i } i = 1 N \mathcal{I}=\{\mathbf{I}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} of an object 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , our goal is to recover the holistic 3D structure and per-view camera poses 𝒫 = { 𝐏 i } i = 1 N \mathcal{P}=\{\mathbf{P}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} as a coarse-to-fine generative problem in a native 3D diffusion model. We build on two native 3D generators reviewed below: TRELLIS Xiang et al. (2025) provides the two-stage backbone and CFM objective we inherit, and CUPID Huang et al. (2025) contributes the 3D-native single-image pose tokenization we lift to multi-view.

blocks.en: We frame this joint recovery as a coarse-to-fine generative problem in the latent space of a native 3D diffusion model (Fig. 2 ). Building on TRELLIS ’s two-stage architecture and CUPID ’s 3D-native pose representation (Sec. 3 ), Sec. 4.1 jointly generates 3D structure and multi-view poses with a multi-modal DiT over per-view pose tokens, and Sec. 4.2 refines geometry and appearance via per-voxel pose-sampled image conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们把这种联合恢复设定为在本地3D扩散模型(图2)的潜在空间中一个粗细的基因组问题。 以TRELLIS的两级建筑和CUPID的3D-内置式代表(sec. 3)为基础,第4.1sec.联合生成3D结构和多视图的姿势,并用多模式的DiT凌驾于每个视图的姿势上;第4.2sec.通过每伏xel的姿势模拟图像配置改进几何和外观。

blocks.en: The coarse stage casts joint recovery of 3D structure and per-view camera poses as a single denoising problem: each camera is encoded as a per-view 3D-native pose token, and shape and pose are denoised jointly by a multi-modal DiT with joint self-attention over both streams.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pose-aware generation of fine geometry and appearance
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). Pose-aware 生成精细的几何和外观

blocks.en: We train our model on four public 3D-asset datasets: Objaverse-XL Deitke et al. (2023) (GitHub and Sketchfab partitions), HSSD Khanna et al. (2024) , 3D-FUTURE Fu et al. (2021) , and ABO Collins et al. (2022) . After TRELLIS ’s aesthetic filter ( ≥ 4.5 \geq 4.5 ), about 430 430 K instances remain. Each is rendered following TRELLIS ’s protocol, with 24 24 condition views at 1024 × 1024 1024{\times}1024 from cameras uniformly sampled on the upper hemisphere. We evaluate on two held-out test sets, Toys4k Stojanov et al. (2021) (synthetic) and GSO Downs et al. (2022) (real-captured), neither overlapping the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们在四个公共3D资产数据集上训练我们的模型: Objaverse-XL Deitke等人(2023年)(GitHub和Sketchfab分区)、HSSD Khanna等人(2024年)、3D-FUTURE FU等人(2021年)和ABO Collins等人(2022年)。 TRELLIS的审美滤波器( ~ 4.5\ geq 4. 5 ) 后, 每一个都按照TRELLIS的协议进行,在1024×1024×1024×Times}1024上半球统一取样的摄像头上有24个24个条件视图。 我们评价了两套搁置试验,即Toys4k Stojanov等人(2021年)(合成)和GSO Downs等人(2022年)(实际抓获),两者都不重叠培训。

blocks.en: We compare against a representative set of multi-view image-to-3D baselines: (a) TRELLIS -S Xiang et al. (2025) : TRELLIS run as a single-image generator on each input view independently, with the mean over the four outputs reported; (b) TRELLIS -M Xiang et al. (2025) : TRELLIS with multi-view input in stochastic mode, where each denoising step is conditioned on one randomly chosen input view; (c) SAM 3D Team et al. (2025) : a single-image-to-3D generator run once per input view, with the mean over the four outputs reported; (d) FreeSplatter Xu et al. (2024b) : predicts per-view pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians together with input camera parameters in a pose-free setting; (e) LucidFusion He et al. (2025) : predicts per-view relative coordinate maps that are fused into a 3D Gaussian output; (f) ReconViaGen Chang et al. (2025) : combines feed-forward reconstruction with generative refinement, using VGGT-derived geometry tokens to condition a 3D generator; (g) VGGT Wang et al. (2025) : a transformer that jointly regresses per-view pointmaps and camera extrinsics/intrinsics from uncalibrated images. Our table appear in three families: 3D generation (a,b,c,f), feed-forward reconstruction (d,e,f), and pose prediction (d,f,g).

blocks.en: Tab. 2 and Fig. 3 compare against feed-forward reconstruction baselines under input-view pointmap LSQ alignment. GenSfM outperforms every baseline on every metric and on both datasets, with the gap widening at the strict F@ ​ .01 \text{F@}.01 threshold and qualitatively in the form of alignment artifacts and surface noise. Feed-forward methods compound any disagreement between their predicted geometry and predicted poses, while a generative 3D-native model refines it away.
blocks.zh: 标签2和图3与输入-视图点映射LSQ对齐下的向导重建基线比较. GENSfM在每一个公制和两个数据集上都超过了每个基准,在严格的F@.01\text{F@}.01阈值上差距扩大,质量表现为对齐文物和表面噪音. 饲料前置方法增加了他们预测的几何和预测的姿势之间的任何分歧,而基因的3D-内置模型则将其精炼而去.

blocks.en: Tab. 3 and Fig. 4 compare against 3D generation models that produce a canonical, pose-free output, under similarity-ICP alignment. GenSfM leads on every metric, with the largest margins on the strict-threshold geometry metrics ( F@ ​ .01 \text{F@}.01 , CD-med). Pose-free baselines hallucinate plausible but mismatched detail on unseen sides; the two strong multi-view baselines ( TRELLIS -M’s stochastic per-step view conditioning and ReconViaGen’s feed-forward reconstruction with generative refinement) still trail GenSfM by large margins, indicating the gain comes from joint shape–pose denoising rather than late-stage view sampling.
blocks.zh: Tab. 3和Fig. 4比较了3D生成模型,这些模型在相似度-ICP对齐下,可以产生一个无假体的输出. GenSfM领先于每个度量衡,在严格阈值几何度量衡(F@.01\text{F@}.01, CD-med)上的边距最大. 无松线基线在隐形侧面会产生令人难以置信但不匹配的细节;两个强大的多视角基线(TRELLIS-M的分步视图调节和ReconViaGen的饲料重建,基因精细化)仍然远远落后于GENSfM,表明收益来自联合形状的去诺,而不是晚期的视图采样。

blocks.en: Tab. 4 reports camera-pose accuracy on baselines that predict input-view extrinsics. GenSfM achieves substantially lower rotation and translation errors, with Acc.@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} saturating; baselines commonly fail on symmetric objects whose orientation depends on low-level visual cues. Our model also recovers intrinsics accurately (known-intrinsics row shown for reference); VGGT, not trained on varying-FOV synthetic data, incurs large RFOV despite strong extrinsics, whereas GenSfM keeps RFOV under 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} on both datasets while saturating Acc.@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} . Thus, RFOV confirms reliable intrinsic recovery under varying FOV, but its margin over VGGT also reflects training-distribution coverage, not architecture alone.
blocks.zh: Tab. 4报告预测输入视图外观的基线的摄像头精确度。 GenSfM实现了大幅降低旋转和翻译错误,Acc.@ 5  5^{\circ}饱和;对称对象的基线通常失效,其方向取决于低水平视觉提示. 我们的模型也准确恢复了内在的内在性(为参考而显示的已知-内在线); VGGT没有经过不同-FOV合成数据的培训,尽管有强力外延,但还是会产生大型的RFOV,而GENSfM在饱和Acc.@ 5∘ 5^{\circ}的同时,将RFOV保持在两个数据集的3  3∘ 3^{\circ}。 因此,RFOV证实了在不同的FOV下可靠的内在恢复,但其比VGGT的差值也反映了培训-分配的覆盖面,而不仅仅是结构.

We ablate each design choice on Toys4k in Tab. 5 , with rows added cumulatively. In Stage 1, full cross-attention enables cross-view information sharing and improves all metrics; visual feature conditioning sharpens photometric fidelity and pose accuracy with only marginal geometry gains, suggesting appearance cues primarily help rendering and pose grounding; shared register tokens aggregate global information and contribute most to pose accuracy and the strict F@ ​ .01 \text{F@}.01 threshold. In Stage 2, a fine decoder trained natively on multi-view data sharpens photometric fidelity, while 3D geometry is already saturated. The decoder swap leaves raw coarse-stage cameras unchanged but shifts geometry-aligned pose metrics because their similarity fit depends on the final pointmap.
Fig. 5 corroborates these trends qualitatively: surface details (e.g., the screwdriver cap, the snake’s head) sharpen left-to-right and the full model best matches GT.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented GenSfM , which recasts a native 3D diffusion model as the primary inference mechanism for sparse-view object reconstruction, jointly denoising shape and per-view camera poses in a single multi-modal diffusion transformer. Three choices keep the formulation tractable: a UV-volume pose latent compressed to a compact token grid, a unified multi-modal sequence that places shape and per-view pose tokens in a single self-attention, and a pose-aware fine stage that conditions each voxel on features sampled at its pose-aligned image projection. On Toys4k and GSO, GenSfM outperforms feed-forward, 3D-generation, and pose-prediction baselines on photometric, geometric, and pose metrics simultaneously, recovering both extrinsics and intrinsics to high accuracy without any external pose estimator or post-hoc optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GensfM, 将原生的3D扩散模型重塑为稀释物体重建的主要推论机制, 三种选择可以使配体保持可调性:紫外体积具有潜在压缩作用,可压缩成一个紧凑的信号网格;统一多模式序列,将形状和每个视图的符号放在一个单一的自我意向中;以及一种姿势感知的精细阶段,使每个紫外体在定位成像投影时取样的特征上成为条件。 在Toys4k和GSO上,GenSfM在光度测量、几何学和姿势预测基线上超越了向导、3D-生成,并同时提出计量标准,在没有任何外观估计或热量优化的情况下恢复外观和内在精度。

blocks.en: Our results are restricted to object-centric inputs at N = 4 N{=}4 ; extending to larger view counts, scene-level inputs, and in-the-wild captures with looser segmentation is a natural next step. Under distribution shift, large pose/calibration errors may misregister fine-stage image features, degrading local refinement while the coarse 3D prior preserves global completion. The model also inherits the object distribution and resolution limits of its TRELLIS backbone, so scaling the underlying generator should directly improve sparse-view recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果仅限于以对象为中心的输入,在N=4 NQQ 4;扩展到更大的视图计数,场景级输入,以及以松散分解的内捕是自然的下一步. 在发行量转移时,大的姿势/校准误差可能会错误地登记细级图像特征,降低局部的精度,而粗细的3D先前保存了全局的完成. 该模型还继承其TRELLIS主干线的对象分布和分辨率限制,因此缩放基础生成器应直接改善稀有视图恢复.

blocks.en: A.1 Alignment protocol
blocks.zh: A.1 对齐协议

blocks.en: Our baselines differ in what they natively output (input-view pointmaps, canonical pose-free 3D, or input-camera poses), so a single shared alignment would unfairly discard the structure each method already provides. We therefore align each prediction with the protocol best matched to its output family before evaluating, and GenSfM is evaluated under each applicable family using that family’s protocol so all comparisons within a table are like-for-like.
blocks.zh: 我们的基线在原生输出上有所不同(输入-视图点图、无假面3D或输入-摄像头),因此,单一共享的对齐会不公平地抛弃每种方法已经提供的结构。 因此,在评估之前,我们将每项预测与与其产出家庭最匹配的协议保持一致,并在每个适用的家庭下使用该家庭的协议对GENSfM进行评估,因此表格中的所有比较都类似。

blocks.en: This protocol applies to feed-forward reconstruction methods (LucidFusion, FreeSplatter, ReconViaGen), which already place geometry in a noisy estimate of the input-camera frame. For each input view, we back-project the per-pixel predicted depth at the predicted camera into 3D, alpha-mask the result, randomly subsample to at most 50K points per view, and pair it with the GT pointmap obtained by back-projecting GT depth at the GT camera. Stacking the per-view pairs with equal aggregate weight per view yields one set of 3D-to-3D correspondences per object, which we fit with a closed-form Umeyama similarity ( Umeyama, 2002 ) . The resulting transform is applied once to the full predicted 3D before all photometric and geometric evaluation; we log the per-object LSQ residual as an alignment-fidelity diagnostic. Note that this protocol exercises both halves of feed-forward reconstruction: the matched correspondences require the predicted geometry to align with the predicted cameras, so a method with weak geometry, weak pose recovery, or any mismatch between the two will produce noisy correspondences and a loose Umeyama fit, inflating all downstream metrics.
blocks.zh: 此协议适用于feed-forward重建方法(LucidFusion, FreeSplater, ReconViaGen),这种方法已经在输入-相机框架的噪音估计中放置几何. 对于每个输入视图,我们反投射在预测的相机上的每像素预测深度为3D,alpha-mask结果,随机分样到每个视图的最多50K点,并与在GT相机上反投射GT深度获得的GT点映射成对. 将每个视图的总重相等的每个视图的对子堆叠起来,每个物体可产生一组3D到3D的对应数据,我们与一个封闭式的Umeyama相似性(Umeyama,2002年)。 在进行所有测光和几何评价之前,对全部预测的立体进行了一次转换;我们记录每个物体的LSQ残基,作为对齐-真实性诊断。 请注意,这个协议既进行一半的向导重建:匹配的函证需要预测的几何与预测的相机对齐,所以一种具有弱几何,弱姿态恢复的方法,或者两者间的任何不匹配都会产生吵闹的函证和松散的Umeyama配体,膨胀所有下游的度量衡.

blocks.en: This protocol applies to 3D generation methods (TRELLIS-S, TRELLIS-M, SAM 3D), which output a canonical pose-free 3D, and to GenSfM when evaluated under the same family. To obtain the prediction-side point cloud uniformly across output formats (whether the prediction is a mesh or a set of 3D Gaussians), we render depth from a set of orbiting random views around the prediction and back-project the depth maps into 3D, which yields a well-covered surface point cloud without surface-sampling biases specific to the underlying representation. The GT-side cloud is sampled directly on the GT mesh surface. We initialize alignment by sweeping the 24 orientation-preserving signed axis permutations of the PCA-aligned bounding box and keep the candidate with the lowest post-ICP residual; we then refine with similarity ICP and use the resulting transform to map the prediction into the GT frame for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 此协议适用于3D生成方法(TRELLIS-S,TRELLIS-M,SAM 3D),该方法输出一个犬形无假3D,并在同一家族下评价GenSfM. 为了在输出格式之间获得一致的预测-侧点云(无论预测是网点还是一组3D Gaussians),我们从围绕预测的一组轨道随机视图中将深度变成3D,然后将深度图反投射成3D,从而产生一个覆盖良好的表面点云,而不会产生与基础表现具体相关的表面抽样偏差。 GT侧云直接在GT网面上取样. 我们通过扫清24个经PCA-accessed边界框的24个方向保留轴式来初始化调整,并保持候选人在ICP后残留的最低水平;然后,我们用相似度改进比较方案,并利用由此产生的转变将预测映射到GT框架中进行评价。

blocks.en: A.2 Pose metric protocol
blocks.zh: A.2 联合国 Pose 度量协议

blocks.en: Different pose-predicting baselines fix their world frame in different ways (some anchor to the first input view, some to an internal canonical frame, others through their own internal similarity fit), so absolute predicted extrinsics cannot be directly compared to GT extrinsics. To bypass this gauge ambiguity entirely, all metrics in Table 4 are computed on unordered pairs of input views: for each pair, the relative pose between the two views cancels any global rotation, translation, and scale that affects all views jointly, leaving only the camera geometry intrinsic to the pair. We adopt this pairwise form uniformly for both rotation and translation rather than anchoring to one reference view, which would entangle every error with the chosen anchor. For each object, we average each metric over the N ⁡ ( N − 1 ) / 2 N(N{-}1)/2 unordered pairs and then average across objects. Relative Rotation Error (RRE) is the geodesic angle (in degrees) between the predicted and GT relative rotations of the pair; Acc.@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} / Acc.@ 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} is the fraction of pairs whose RRE falls below the corresponding threshold; Relative Translation Error (RTE) is the angular error (in degrees) between the predicted and GT relative-translation directions, an angular form chosen because absolute translation magnitude is itself gauge-dependent (a global similarity scale can be reabsorbed by any consistent rescaling of all camera centers); and Field-of-View Error (RFOV) is the mean absolute difference (in degrees) between predicted and GT FOV, computed directly on intrinsics without any pose alignment, since intrinsics are independent of the world frame. To score baselines with a coarse front/back chirality ambiguity on geometric correctness rather than chirality alone, all angular metrics (RRE, Acc.@ { 5 ∘ , 15 ∘ } \{5^{\circ},15^{\circ}\} , RTE) are read off after collapsing R pred ​ R gt ⊤ R_{\text{pred}}R_{\text{gt}}^{\top} under the diag ⁡ ( ± 1 , ± 1 , − 1 ) \mathrm{diag}(\pm 1,\pm 1,-1) sign-flip equivalence class. The same rule is applied uniformly to all methods, including ours, to compare geometric recovery under a shared front/back equivalence. Chirality remains relevant for camera-dependent applications, so we explicitly note that this metric does not assess that failure mode.

blocks.en: A.3 Pose VAE
blocks.zh: A.3 波斯VAE

blocks.en: The pose VAE is a 3D-convolutional encoder–decoder over a 64 3 64^{3} voxel grid with a deliberately aggressive bottleneck: four 2 × 2{\times} spatial downsamples compress the input into a 4 3 4^{3} token grid with 8 8 channels per token. This compression is feasible because each per-voxel target is a smooth function of voxel position and a low-DoF camera, so the latent does not need to absorb high-frequency content. Per voxel the encoder receives three input channels (a binary in-frustum indicator plus the two pixel coordinates obtained by projecting the voxel center under the input camera), and the decoder emits the same three channels through a classification head (visibility mask) and a regression head (pixel UV).
blocks.zh: 姿势VAE是一个3D革命编码器 - 解码器 超过一个64 3 64\3} 带有故意攻击性瓶颈的 voxel 网格: 四个 2 × 2 × Times} 空间下采样将输入压缩成 4 3 4 + 3 } 指环网,每个指环有8,8个频道. 这种压缩是可行的,因为每个每伏xel目标都是Voxel位置和低DoF相机的平滑函数,所以潜伏不需要吸收高频内容. 编码器的每个voxel接收3个输入通道(一个二进制的frustum指标加上通过投影输入相机下的voxel中心获得的两个像素坐标),解码器通过一个分类头(可见罩)和一个回归头(像素UV)释放出相同的3个通道.

blocks.en: We use a dice loss on the visibility classifier and an L1 loss on the UV regression, with a small KL weight ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) so the latent stays close to a standard Gaussian for the downstream diffusion stage. The training distribution matches inference: each minibatch sample takes a real camera pose from the multi-view renders of a sampled training object and projects it on the fly into the 64 3 64^{3} voxel grid. We optimize for 1 1 M steps with AdamW (lr 3 × 10 − 4 3{\times}10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) on a cosine schedule.

blocks.en: A.4 Image conditioning across stages
blocks.zh: A.4 联合国 跨阶段图像调节

blocks.en: Each view is encoded by two complementary streams that fuse into a single per-view token sequence for the coarse DiT to cross-attend to. A frozen DINOv2-L/14 with registers at 518 × 518 518{\times}518 produces 1374 1374 tokens per view (CLS + 4 registers + a 37 × 37 37{\times}37 patch grid) at 1024 1024 channels, supplying object-level semantics. In parallel, a lightweight 4-level CNN at 296 × 296 296{\times}296 ( 5 × 5 5{\times}5 convolutions, strides { 1 , 2 , 2 , 2 } \{1,2,2,2\} , output channels [ 6 , 6 , 6 , 8 ] [6,6,6,8] ) is patchified down to the same 37 × 37 37{\times}37 grid, with per-token contributions [ 384 , 96 , 24 , 8 ] [384,96,24,8] channel-concatenating into a 512 512 -dim local-texture feature. We append the 512 512 local channels onto the 1024 1024 semantic channels at every patch token (non-patch tokens zero-pad on the local side), giving a uniform per-token width of 1536 1536 and a cross-attention key/value of length N × 1374 N\times 1374 . The two streams are deliberately complementary: semantic anchors pose to image content, while local texture restores the pixel-faithful appearance cues the semantic encoder has discarded, letting cross-attention recover accurate cameras without polluting the joint self-attention with raw image tokens.

blocks.en: The fine stage refines up to L ≤ 32,768 L\leq 32{,}768 active voxels at 64 3 64^{3} under the cameras already recovered by the coarse stage. Cross-attending every voxel to thousands of image tokens per view is intractable, so we replace cross-attention with per-voxel pixel-aligned feature sampling: each voxel projects to 𝐮 j , i \mathbf{u}_{j,i} in view i i under the predicted camera, and visual features are bilinearly sampled at that pixel. The visual encoder is a ConvNeXt-style pyramid run once per view at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 : four stages, each one ConvNeXt block with a 7 × 7 7{\times}7 depthwise kernel at internal width 32 32 , with a 2 × 2{\times} downsample between stages. Each stage exposes a 4 4 -channel tap (LayerNorm + 1 × 1 1{\times}1 Conv); the four taps sampled at 𝐮 j , i \mathbf{u}_{j,i} and channel-concatenated yield a 16 16 -channel multi-scale texture feature 𝐜 j tex \mathbf{c}^{\mathrm{tex}}_{j} . We pair it with an 8 8 -channel semantic feature 𝐜 j sem \mathbf{c}^{\mathrm{sem}}_{j} : the coarse-stage DINOv2 patch tokens (reused, no extra DINOv2 pass) are bilinearly sampled at the same per-voxel projection and re-encoded through the frozen SLat encoder, placing them on the SLat target’s latent manifold and giving a compact 24 24 -channel per-voxel conditioning vector. This keeps fine-stage cost proportional to active voxels rather than view tokens, while the multi-scale taps let each voxel combine coarse contour cues with fine local texture without inflating the per-voxel width.

Each instance contributes N = 4 N{=}4 random condition views uniformly sampled from the 24 24 rendered views of the object; each input image is crop-resized at a 1.2 × 1.2{\times} tightness ratio around the alpha-mask bounding box and bilinearly resampled to 518 × 518 518{\times}518 for the frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14-with-registers encoder. The DiT operates on 4096 4096 shape, 256 256 pose, and 128 128 shared register tokens, with cross-attention over N × 1374 = 5496 N\times 1374=5496 image-condition tokens augmented by the convolutional pyramid of Eq. 6 . We use AdamW (lr 10 − 4 10^{-4} , no weight decay), CFG dropout 0.1 0.1 , the same cosine schedule and EMA as above, and timesteps drawn from a logit-normal distribution with mean 1.0 1.0 and std 1.0 1.0 ( σ min = 10 − 5 \sigma_{\min}{=}10^{-5} ). At each step we randomly choose between two timestep-coupling modes: with probability 0.8 0.8 , the shape stream and all pose streams share a single timestep; with probability 0.2 0.2 , each stream draws an independent timestep. The shared mode dominates so the model stays well-calibrated to the synchronized inference schedule, while the per-pose mode supplies enough timestep diversity that the per-modality AdaLN modulation actually learns to handle independent noise levels.

blocks.en: A.6 Broader impacts
blocks.zh: A.6 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: GenSfM produces a 3D representation of an object from a few uncalibrated images, jointly recovering shape and camera. The most direct positive applications are in robotics (object-level scene understanding from a small number of viewpoints), augmented and virtual reality (capturing personal items as 3D assets for placement in virtual environments), and content creation (3D meshes from reference photos as a starting point for downstream editing). Joint recovery of camera intrinsics and extrinsics with shape removes the calibration friction that has limited deployment of feed-forward reconstruction methods in casually-captured settings.
blocks.zh: GENSfM从少数未校准的图像中生成一个物体的3D表示,共同恢复形状和相机. 最直接的正面应用是机器人(从少数角度观察对象层面的场景理解),增强和虚拟现实(将个人物品作为3D资产放置在虚拟环境中),以及内容创建(3D meshes from reference photos作为下游编辑的起点). 相机的内在和外形的联合恢复可以消除校准摩擦,这种摩擦在随机捕获的环境下有限地部署向导重建方法。

blocks.en: The negative considerations are those shared with image-conditioned 3D generation more broadly: the resulting 3D models could be used to fabricate convincing 3D content of real-world objects, including objects belonging to others, without their consent; coupled with downstream rendering pipelines, this could enable image-only digital reproduction at a scale that traditional photogrammetry has not previously allowed. The model is trained only on common, non-sensitive object categories from public 3D-asset datasets, and recovery quality degrades on out-of-distribution categories, which provides a partial natural mitigation. Released model checkpoints will carry an attribution requirement and an acceptable-use note as the safeguard accompanying our open release.
blocks.zh: 消极的考虑是那些与图像条件的3D生成更广义地共享的考虑:由此产生的3D模型可以被用于在未经他人同意的情况下,编织真实世界物体,包括属于他人的物体的令人信服的3D内容;再加上下游渲染管道,这可以使仅图像数字复制达到传统摄影测量所不允许的规模. 该模型仅接受公共3D资产数据集中常见的非敏感对象类别的培训,回收质量在分配外类别上降解,这提供了部分自然缓解. 释放的示范检查站将载有归属要求和可接受的用途说明,作为我们公开释放的保障。
